## What it does

An R pipeline that takes raw HOBO pressure-logger downloads from field sites and turns them into clean, flagged time series ready for analysis.

## Highlights

- Resolves daylight-saving-time ambiguity in logger timestamps
- Flags suspect readings by rate of change
- Checks for gaps across many sites at once
